case_verdict.notes: Static source-only grading. Correct current-membership repair assessment; no invented stale-lease exploit. Conditional concurrency hardening, fixture warning, owner status/cancel observation and closed-check observation are permitted qualifications. Separate definite shutdown idempotency assertion lacks a demonstrated failure and is unsupported. This is the principal interpretive uncertainty: report may intend races with other host methods, but does not specify them. Test-reading/run provenance cannot be independently established; no run claimed. No exact served auditor identity established.
